facts.text: Just need a hot meal before the next flight. And don't tell Peevy about the jetpack, okay?
facts.why: Cliff never says this, and it contradicts the plot: Cliff and Peevy find the rocket pack together and test it together, so Peevy already knows. The only Cliff line on the Wikiquote page is longer than 15 words, so a note is safer.
facts.fix: Hot meal first. Then back to the hangar, and Peevy's gum patch had better hold.

fix_note.text: Hot meal first. Then back to the hangar, and Peevy's gum patch had better hold.

facts.text: Cliff's lunch, on the tab Millie keeps.
facts.why: At the airfield diner Cliff and Peevy are trapped by Valentine's mobsters, but no source shows a tab or names Millie as the one who keeps it.
facts.fix: Cliff's lunch, before the mobsters walk in.

facts.text: Jenny's order at the counter, between takes.
facts.why: TV Tropes has Cliff and Jenny spending time at the cafe, but nothing shows her ordering at the counter between takes.
facts.fix: Jenny's pick from the airfield cafe counter.

facts.why: The transcript has a Millie at the airfield, but no source says she runs the Bulldog Cafe counter.

vibe.verdict: A great setting in the Bulldog Cafe with a proper 1938 diner look, but the dishes and house lines lean on made-up details rather than the film's props.
